card.title: IPad 7 Not Turning On Error 4013 Repair

source.title: IPad 7 Not Turning On Error 4013 Repair

claims.statement: iPad 7 no power, bootloops or restore error 4013 (passing a Tristar tester) is commonly CPU solder joint failure from board flex; a CPU reball is the fix.
Success isn't guaranteed (CPU may be internally damaged) and re-failure rates are high.

procedure: Confirm 4013 and rule out battery, charging IC and NAND.
Preheat, remove CPU, clean, reball, refit.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: CPU reballing is advanced work with a high re-failure rate.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
